The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4b54d35506a19280), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume P ν sup |Kν| ≤ LC1 , where m0, C1 are fixed independently of J. For every fixed E > 0 there is Eid > 0, depending only on E and the fixed group data, such that sup Θ∈R ∥Tζ(Θ)∥2→2 ≤ L−Eid has the following consequence for all sufficiently large fixed J. Let I = [X, 2X), with xγ ≤ X ≤ x1/γ for fixed γ > 0. If f is supported on positions in I, is independent of the chosen marks, and satisfies sup |f| ≤ exp(O( √ L)), ∥f∥, ∥g∥ ≤ X1/2 LC3 , then |⟨f, Aζg⟩| ≪ XL−E+2C3 . (6.7) The lower bound on J may also depend on m0, C1. The threshold for x may depend on J, C2, γ. No further restriction on ζ is imposed beyond the ideal norm hypothesis. Taking absolute values of the individual transition coefficients gives row and column sums at most LCabs , where Cabs is independent of J.
